evidence: ios/Runner/Info.plist has no NSCameraUsageDescription, NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription or NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription while image_picker is used

evidence: AppDatabase.openDatabase has no onConfigure PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON in the inspected openDatabase call
recommendation: Enable PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON in onConfigure and validate migrations

evidence: No dedicated pre-FK orphan cleanup was identified in the database opening path
recommendation: Add audit/cleanup migration before enforcing foreign keys

evidence: Model toMap methods do not expose forUpdate; updates use toMap()..remove(id) patterns
recommendation: Introduce update-safe serialization for records with create/update-only fields

evidence: Workout creation awaits DB writes directly in UI path; no local try/catch around the main save path was visible in sampled code
recommendation: Wrap save flows with user-visible error state and retry-safe behavior

evidence: Photo save path awaits picker, file copy and DB insert without visible try/catch in sampled code

evidence: FutureBuilder waits for hasData and does not render snapshot.error explicitly
recommendation: Render retryable error state when profiles cannot load

evidence: EveFitHome uses body: SafeArea(child: _screens[_index]) instead of IndexedStack
recommendation: Use IndexedStack to preserve tab state during navigation
